description: Gate that prevents deprioritized or flagged companies from appearing in dashboard action items. Called before surfacing any action item naming a company. A 92% match score on a deprioritized company must never surface as 'apply now' — the flag wins over the score.
litmus: Run HOW.py with company + action + flags_file — exit 0=PASS (action allowed), exit 1=BLOCK (company flagged), exit 2=WARN (referral in flight).

files.HOW.py: Enforcement gate — call before surfacing any job action for a named company
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — scans enforcement log for bypass detections
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — emits keep/strengthen/kill verdict based on block rate

origin_incident: 2026-05-04: flagged companies (OpenAI, Google) were appearing in action items despite active flags in company-flags.json.
